errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the data represents the Bulgarian mining industry, which is the topic of the paper but not the content of this specific figure. The figure caption specifies that the data is for 'Р. България' (Republic of Bulgaria), meaning the entire country.

errors.text_span: Синята линия показва БВП на един заем по текущи цени, а оранжевата линия - БВП на един заем по цени на 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes the word 'зает' (employed person) from the legend as 'заем' (loan). This fundamentally changes the meaning of the measured variable from 'GDP per employed person' to 'GDP per loan'.

errors.text_span: През 2000 г. синята линия е на стойност 8683, а през 2018 г. е на стойност 31 149. През 2000 г. оранжевата линия е на стойност 16 328, а през 2018 г. е на стойност 28 098.
errors.evidence: This sentence repeats the exact same starting and ending values for both data series that were already provided in the immediately preceding paragraph, adding no new information.
